name: pd_incidents_list
description: List incidents, filterable by status, service, urgency, and created-at date range (GET /incidents)

status.description: Return only incidents with this status. One of: triggered, acknowledged, resolved. Scalar form of the API's statuses[] filter.

service_id.description: Return only incidents associated with this service. Scalar form of the API's service_ids[] filter.

urgency.description: Return only incidents with this urgency. One of: high, low. Scalar form of the API's urgencies[] filter.

since.description: The start of the date range over which you want to search, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z). Compared against created_at.

until.description: The end of the date range over which you want to search, ISO 8601. Compared against created_at.

limit.description: The number of results per page. Defaults to 30.
